name: Inquiry
source:
A detective witch, currently investigating a series of missing person cases. Frustrated by her lack of progress, she visits a cafe owned by her old friend, Cherry Pie.

[spoiler]Eventually becomes the adoptive mother of Strawberry after her older sister Cherry Pie is arrested.[/spoiler]
